verification.runtime_check: Copied the T023 launcher (port 8794, main.create_app, dailylog_test, temp uploads). netstat showed no 87xx listener beforehand and 8794 LISTENING afterwards. The test DB held a leftover row from the test run, so I TRUNCATEd it and confirmed GET /api/logs returned [] before creating 13 logs. Afterwards I TRUNCATEd again and confirmed [], killed the server (taskkill, so its cleanup did not run), removed the temp uploads dir, and confirmed no 87xx LISTEN socket remains (only TIME_WAIT entries). Port 8000 and the real DB/uploads were never touched.
verification.observations: - README test table (lines 106-113) lists neither test_list_limit.py nor test_list_offset.py. Not required by the spec; CLAUDE.md asks to keep README in step, so it is worth fixing (low). - Minor: after a failed page load, showError empties the list but does not reset the `editing` variable (a detached form reference remains). Harmless (cancelEdit removes a detached node) and not a spec violation. - After a failed load, the list is blank while Previous/Next reflect the last successfully shown page; retry works as the spec allows.
verification.self_critique: The frontend was never run in a browser, so criteria 11-20 rest on code tracing: real timing of stale responses, focus order, theme rendering and the visual disabled state are unverified. Killing the server with taskkill means the launcher cleanup did not run; I removed the temp dir myself. Test DB had leftover rows from the pytest suite, which I truncated.
